component.name: Uzume
component.summary: Self-hosted retro gaming: library, saves and shared sessions

description.p: Uzume plays retro games on your PC from a central ROM library on your own Uzume server, keeps your saves versioned, and shares game sessions with friends directly between apps.
The app contains no games, BIOS files or firmware, and no emulator cores: cores are downloaded from your Uzume server when needed.
